title: MODEL_TRAINING_NATIVE converge to Xingcheng-owned boundary and canonical units drop retired members
summary: Human-governor directive 2026-10-02: (1) MODEL_TRAINING_NATIVE still carries tool-era semantics - parent UNIT_ENGINE, dependencies listing local-model, bare 'training-owned job state' data authority - contradicting architecture-tool-local-model and B81 SERVICE-BOUNDARY; reparented under UNIT_ASSISTANT (BLOCK_XINGCHENG, same unit as XINGCHENG_INSTITUTION_ROOT), local-model dependency replaced by the actual authorities, Xingcheng-exclusive data-authority wording restored, enclave logical boundary declared against the new top-level physical root that xingcheng-physical-root-migration-20261002-r2 already rebound. (2) Canonical unit membership still lists retired identities: UNIT_RUNTIME lists retired SUB_SOVEREIGN_LAYER, UNIT_DATA lists retired QDRANT_AUTHORITY, UNIT_ASSISTANT lists retired STAR_DIRECTORY, and UNIT_ENGINE lists retired MODEL_TRAINING plus xingcheng-internal names (xingcheng-engine|auto-learning|auto-repair) that belong to the separate Xingcheng institution, not the model/engine unit; membership lists are corrected at canonical source so directory resolvers stop seeing 'retired' and 'active member' simultaneously. UNIT_ENGINE logical_boundary drops its 'xingcheng execution domain' claim consistent with B162 separation. Both canonical rows and a233_normalized_directory_entry projections are updated in the same revision so canonical and projection never diverge. Codex/registry-only change: no implementation or file is moved by this request. Reuses the governor-reviewed r3 change set with physical-path text updated to the post-r2 top-level xingcheng root and membership corrections added.
origin: direct human-governor instruction 2026-10-02: canonical architecture directory still places retired identities in active unit membership (UNIT_RUNTIME->SUB_SOVEREIGN_LAYER, UNIT_DATA->QDRANT_AUTHORITY, UNIT_ASSISTANT->STAR_DIRECTORY, UNIT_ENGINE->MODEL_TRAINING) and MODEL_TRAINING_NATIVE still depends on local-model under UNIT_ENGINE; Xingcheng and local-model codex topology must be truly decoupled per B81/B162

problem.summary: MODEL_TRAINING_NATIVE canonical row claims dependency on local-model and sits under UNIT_ENGINE, contradicting the codified Xingcheng/local-model separation (physical_root already migrated to the top-level xingcheng tree by xingcheng-physical-root-migration-20261002-r2; ownership fields not yet converged). Active canonical units still list retired activation-state identities as members: UNIT_RUNTIME->SUB_SOVEREIGN_LAYER (retired), UNIT_DATA->QDRANT_AUTHORITY (retired), UNIT_ASSISTANT->STAR_DIRECTORY (retired), UNIT_ENGINE->MODEL_TRAINING (retired) plus xingcheng-engine|auto-learning|auto-repair which are internal to the separate Xingcheng institution. Directory resolver, dependency checker and inventory scanner currently see 'retired' and 'active member' simultaneously for the same identities.
